parsed.explanation: Worst features are state-imposed universal exposures: a national document/visa regime (X markers barred, case-note tagging, refusal on sex-discrepancy doubt) in force and upheld; facility bans reaching ~22 states, criminal trespass in 4, with one documented arrest and men's-ward detention; conversion-therapy-style custody and immigration-detention abuse. Recourse partially failed (passport rule upheld). Offsetting: no trans-specific criminalisation or killings documented, functioning courts enjoining some orders, hate-crime statute, legal aid, 37+ units without mapped bans. Rule 21's band implication puts documented universal exposure without a working remedy in Elevated Risk, but absence of identity criminalisation, killings and a live civil society keeps it above High Risk.
